svg.title: Personal records — illustrated retrieval and owner-reported purchase support
svg.desc: Illustrative conversations and fictional data. Owner-only records answer a landscaper start date and report an HVAC amount from a paid receipt. The purchase-support sequence reconstructs the owner's completed personal OpenClaw workflow: find purchase and support details, extract the serial number, describe the defect photo, send the inquiry and follow up when a response arrives. Life-index itself remains read-only.

path.aria-label: What did I pay for the last
